strategy.name: Heikin Ashi + SuperTrend — Pro Colour Variant
strategy.description: Long-only, colour-timed trend strategy that only trades inside a confirmed up-regime and sizes every trade by risk. Enter on the first green Heikin-Ashi candle while the regime gate is open; exit on the first red candle, a regime break, or the ATR stop. Sharpened from the base HA+SuperTrend plan through systematic testing and validated out-of-sample. Full plan: docs/heiken-ashi-supertrend-pro.md.

indicators.supertrend: Regime direction. ATR(10) x 3.0. Must be bullish (line below price) for longs to be allowed.
indicators.ema_200: Trend filter. Price must be above EMA(200).
indicators.ema_50: Regime confirmation. EMA(50) must be above EMA(200) — the medium-term structure has turned up.
indicators.heikin_ashi: Entry and exit timing. Enter on the first green candle inside the regime; exit on the first red candle.
indicators.atr_10: Risk unit. The 2x ATR stop defines both the hard stop and the position size.

bearish: Any regime condition fails — strategy stands aside (long-only, no shorts)

long: Regime gate open: SuperTrend bullish AND close > EMA(200) AND EMA(50) > EMA(200)
Current Heikin-Ashi candle is green (haClose > haOpen)
short: None — this variant is long-only. Shorts were a net drag in testing; in a downtrend the strategy stays flat, not short.

exit_rules: Exit on the first red Heikin-Ashi candle (haClose < haOpen) — the primary, win-rate exit
Exit on a regime break: SuperTrend flips bearish, or close falls below EMA(200), or EMA(50) crosses below EMA(200)
Hard stop: 2 x ATR(10) below entry — the disaster brake
No breakeven stop, no scale-out, no trailing stop — each was tested and each reduced performance
risk_rules: Risk-based sizing: size each trade so hitting the 2x ATR stop loses a fixed % of equity (the return dial — 2% prudent, 5% aggressive)
One position at a time — no pyramiding, no averaging down
Maximum trade size capped by MAX_TRADE_SIZE_USD in .env
Maximum trades per day capped by MAX_TRADES_PER_DAY in .env
Never override the exit — the decision tree exits you
Paper trade on your specific asset and timeframe before going live
notes: Long-only, colour-timed, regime-gated, risk-sized. Best on 1H/4H/1D. Expect a low win rate (~37% on daily BTC) with profit factor around 1.9-2.1: many small losses, a few trend legs that carry it. Validated out-of-sample (era-by-era plus a 2023-07 train/test split where the unseen test period matched the training period). Risk % sets the drawdown — 5% gave ~24% max drawdown historically. The regime gate keeps you flat, not short, in downtrends. Single-asset (BTC) validation only; re-check on your market before going live.
